policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For three blue and two green, complete green before blue in the layout with the bin near [90, 148], and blue before green in the layout with the bin near [101, 141].
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For three blue and two green, complete green before blue in the layout with the bin near [90, 148], and blue before green in the layouts with the bin near [101, 141] or [112, 161]. For one blue and two green with the bin near [109, 100], complete green before blue.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For one red with the bin near [117, 169], select red near [98, 84].
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For one red with the bin near [117, 169], select red near [98, 84]. For three blue and two green with the bin near [112, 161], select blue near [66, 141], [81, 71], or [94, 131] when blue_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two; after completing the blue quota, select green near [78, 109] or [72, 172] when green_deposited is respectively zero or one. For two red with the bin near [118, 175], select red near [105, 118] or [60, 163] when red_deposited is respectively zero or one. For two red with the bin near [95, 162], select red near [53, 80] or [77, 139] when red_deposited is respectively zero or one. For three red with the bin near [109, 112], select red near [113, 142], [70, 82], or [95, 158] when red_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two. For one blue and two green with the bin near [109, 100], select green near [108, 152] or [75, 88] when green_deposited is respectively zero or one; after completing the green quota, select blue near [117, 71] while blue_deposited is zero.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Match approximate target locations to current visible free cubes of the selected color.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Match approximate target locations to current free cubes of the selected color using the current scene and supplied execution interval, not remembered initial observations or exact pixel equality. Use the visible cube arrangement together with the bin to distinguish layouts, including the three-red layouts near [109, 112] and [110, 130]. All pickup preferences use updated counters and apply only with an empty hand and unmet quotas; they never override B for a currently held requested cube or C when all quotas are satisfied.

edits.modify_from: This establishes a completed deposit unless the interval shows the carried cube falling or being released outside the bin.
edits.modify_to: This is positive evidence of a completed deposit. Override it only if continuity in the supplied interval positively tracks that same carried cube being released or falling outside the bin. An independently visible free cube, whether persistent or newly appearing and even of the same color, is not such evidence. The elevated release pose may project above and to either side of the bin center; that image-coordinate offset alone does not establish an outside release.
